name: aviron-rescue-platform
description: AVIRON - Autonomous Rescue, Observation & Intelligent Response Network

scripts.setup: cd backend && cmd /c npm install && cmd /c npx prisma db push && cmd /c npx prisma db seed && cd ../frontend && cmd /c npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cmd /c npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && cmd /c npm run dev
scripts.build: cd backend && cmd /c npm run build && cd ../frontend && cmd /c npm run build
